issue.title: Installing dependencies for development - composer install or composer update?

repository.name: yii2
repository.description: Yii 2: The Fast, Secure and Professional PHP Framework

issue.body:
[Prepare the testing envinronment](https://github.com/yiisoft/yii2/blob/master/docs/internals/git-workflow.md#3-prepare-the-testing-environment-) section of [Git workflow for Yii2 contributors](https://github.com/yiisoft/yii2/blob/master/docs/internals/git-workflow.md) document says that we need to run `composer update` to install dependencies:

> run `composer update` to install dependencies (assuming you have composer installed globally).

But why not `composer install`? `composer.lock` exists in project and under version control. It guarantees that every developer will have exactly the same set of dependencies and their versions.

Or am I missing something? Is it related to features of Composer Asset Plugin?

Running `composer install` is not even possible now because of #12946.

body: this depends on the php version installed on dev machine. will fix it.
@arogachev @dynasource for verification, could you provide the php version you used for testing

I simply did the following:
- use the guide https://github.com/yiisoft/yii2/blob/master/docs/internals/git-workflow.md#3-prepare-the-testing-environment-
- git clone https://github.com/yiisoft/yii2.git
- composer install

I have updated composer.json to contain a target platform so that dependencies should now be installable on different platforms. This works on travis as of https://travis-ci.org/yiisoft/yii2/builds/174347785 please also check if it works for you now.
